references.repo_policy: All committed PVGames reference files should live under canonical_repo_path, grouped by category with reference_index.json. Do not keep PVGames folders at the repository root.
references.license_summary: Permits use and editing in commercial and non-commercial projects; verify redistribution scope before publishing a public repo containing the resources.
forbidden_use_in_ng: copying, tracing, recoloring, or deriving NG assets directly from the pack
using the pack as final NG art without explicit project approval
scattering pack files outside the canonical reference root
